page.overview:
Who is Adam Warlock?

Adam was created by High Priestess Ayesha to be the "Warlock", the next step in the evolution of the Sovereign, a race of gold-skinned humanoids created by the High Evolutionary. He was developed in a biomechanical cocoon for at least eleven years to grant him the abilities of flight, enhanced strength, and energy projection, all so he could destroy the Guardians of the Galaxy, a mercenary team that had betrayed and humiliated the Sovereign after being hired by them.

Adam was removed from his cocoon early circa 2025 by the High Evolutionary, who sent him to the mining colony Knowhere to apprehend Rocket, a member of the Guardians and an escaped test subject of the High Evolutionary that he wished to study further. When he arrived on Knowhere, he attempted to grab Rocket, but was viciously attacked by the Guardians, being beaten by Drax and Groot, and being stabbed by Nebula. Adam escaped, but not before mortally wounding Rocket with one of his energy blasts.

Returning to Counter-Earth, the High Evolutionary's planet, Adam and Ayesha were given an ultimatum by the High Evolutionary: deliver Rocket to him or he would wipe out the Sovereign completely. The two tracked the Guardians to the Orgoscope, the headquarters for the High Evolutionary's biotech company, OrgoCorp, from where they were able to track the Guardians' ship, the Bowie, and also picked up a small F'Saki called Blurp that Adam took as a pet. They followed the Bowie back to Counter-Earth, the Guardians attempting to get a passkey to disarm a kill switch on Rocket's heart that was keeping them from performing a life-saving operation on him.

Arriving on Counter-Earth, Adam, carrying Blurp with him, flew to the parked Bowie, which was being guarded by the Guardians' ally Gamora with the unconscious Rocket inside. Adam dropped off Blurp in the ship and prepared to face down Gamora, but the High Evolutionary, believing one of his henchman had gotten Rocket, began detonating explosives all over the planet as he took off in his ship, the Arête, which held the rest of the Guardians inside. Panicking, Adam flew back to his own ship, arriving just in time to see it be destroyed by one of the explosives with his mother inside.
